title: Cosmic Cauldron of Realms
description: A surreal steampunk cauldron sits in dark water, containing a glowing orange and black vortex portal. Various ornate metallic orbs, swirling vortexes, crescent shapes, and mechanical objects float around it against a dramatic sunset sky with a distant silhouetted fantasy city.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene at sunset featuring an ornate metallic cauldron in dark water containing a bright orange swirling cosmic vortex. Multiple floating steampunk orbs, mechanical spheres with gears, swirling vortexes, and crescent shapes drift around it. Distant gothic fantasy city silhouette on the horizon under a purple and orange sky, highly detailed, atmospheric lighting.
